title: Informative
text: Laura was a great guide giving a lot of background information and also took her time to answer my questions.
author: Andreas_S

title: Tour was amazing
text: It was beautiful to see the place and the tower. We had a great time. I would recommended it if you like to walk
author: Myriam_P

title: Great tour of Cathedral
text: Very insightful into the history of the Cathedral and having the choice to stay inside when the tour has finished.  Plus not having to queue. Juan was a great guide.
author: Karen_D

title: Easy tour
text:
Very informative and well managed, nice starting point. Easy walk to the cathedral.
Guide stayed to keep the ones behind with the group.
author: Lee_A

title: We did the tour with...
text: We did the tour with Juan. Taking the guided tour was the best decision so as not to miss any detail. Juan has a very dynamic way of talking about key historical facts related to what is seen on the tour of the cathedral. The tour was concise but specific and very entertaining!
author: juliana_o

title: We had a great experience...
text: We had a great experience with Rosa! She highlighted a lot of history and features of the cathedral, and kept it light at the same time.
author: Swachi_J

title: I highly recommend this tour!
text: This tour was top notch. We had so much fun and learned so much. If you’re still wondering what to do in Sevilla, I wouldn’t miss out on this one.
author: Roger_C

title: Seville Cathedral tour
text: Our guide, Rosa, led an informative, comfortably paced tour of the Seville Cathedral. We enjoyed her enthusiasm and knowledge of the site and Seville in general.
author: Patricia_W

title: Terrific Cathedral visit
text: We really enjoyed the Cathedral tour and the walk to the top of La Giralda. Our guide Rosa was delightful. Unfortunately our digital guides stopped working but she soldiered on and we didn’t miss a thing. Would highly recommend.
author: Rita_J

title: So interesting and amazing ….
text: This is nice to have a guide who knows very well the subject ,  I have learned a lot. The architecture is amazing, the history around the cathédrale and the giralda is well explained and very interesting …
author: Laurence_M
